title: Prismatic Flow Structure
description: JSON Structure representation of a Prismatic Flow — an ordered sequence of steps within an integration that begins with a trigger and executes connector actions.
name: Flow

isSynchronous.description: True for request-response flows; false for fire-and-forget.

endpointSecurityType.description: How the inbound webhook endpoint is authenticated.

steps.description: Ordered list of step descriptors composing the flow.
